notes.title: Yasunori Shiono - Mechjestic's Legendary Composer!🌟🎶
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, [b]MERK[/b] here! 💪

I am so proud of this moment!🙏❤️

Just a little story... Me as a young boy in the 90s, playing a game called Lufia 2 on my Super Nintendo... And I was just loving every song that came out of the small TV! I still listen to the OST to this day! For years.. I've worked hard on games for years... Big projects, amazing people and great experiences.

But now... The legendary [b]Yasunori Shiono[/b] is the main composer for Mechjestic! After so many years of being a fan of his work, I can now share a song that is made for the first game I became a Game Director for!😍 That's just [b]AMAZING![/b]🙇❤️

Thanks so much for being part of our project Shiono-San! I hope all of you will enjoy it as much as I do!

~[b]MERK[/b] out!💪

[b]Check out the first track of the Mechjestic OST here:[/b]
[previewyoutube=B2fNuc0Q95U;full][/previewyoutube]
